entities.name: Théâtre des Jeunes-Artistes
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Théâtre des Jeunes-Artistes was an 18th-century Parisian entertainment venue, now defunct, inaugurated in 1790 at 52 rue de Bondy in the 10th arrondissement of Paris. It had a capacity of 520 spectators.
